  • Eastern Shawnee Tribe of Oklahoma↗Historical community association described by OHS
    Connection & source
    Historical community association described by OHS

    The retained Oklahoma Historical Society account traces an Ohio Shawnee–Seneca association through removal negotiations and later community history. This is a historical connection for this entry’s selected account, not a claim that all Shawnee communities or present governments are interchangeable.

    Ohio Shawnee–Seneca association and removal account, 1831–1832. Reviewed 2026-11-18.
